**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us:

- **§3 "Restrictions on Use"** is purely licence-scope: no copying beyond backup/internal use, no reverse engineering, no assignment or sublicence, and no use of the Work "except as authorized herein." Nothing bars us from acquiring, building or licensing competing routing software.
- **§19** is a mutual, reciprocal one-year employee non-solicit — a different category, and it binds Garman equally.
- **§14 Confidentiality** contains no "no competing development" covenant; §14(c) expressly carves out independently developed information, which helps us.
- **§20 General Matters** covers only time of the essence and notices.

Targeted searches for "compet", "develop", "exclusiv", and field-of-use/territory/"engage in" phrasing surfaced nothing binding Sparkling. This sits at the **preferred** position, so no narrowing fallback is needed.
